trickBeats.text: A woman, maybe 60s spends the afternoon with the tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
💡 The tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — THAT's what A woman, maybe 60s was describing. Hickory Nuts. It clicks like a key turning.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nevermore: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
